headline: IEA Forecasts 70% Rise in Datacenter Carbon Emissions by 2030 Driven by AI
summary: The International Energy Agency reported that global datacenter carbon emissions will increase by 70% over the next four years as energy consumption doubles, driven by artificial intelligence infrastructure in the US and China.
why: The IEA advises major economies on energy security and climate goals. High power consumption by tech facilities impacts utility grid planning and fossil fuel demand.
